headline: Oregon attorney general Dan Rayfield sues OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT endangers teens
claim: ChatGPT for Teens lacks adequate safeguards and endangers minors, according to Oregon's lawsuit against OpenAI.
notes: published 2026-11-17 (page date read via WebFetch). Allegations in a state attorney general's complaint (Multnomah County Circuit Court, at least $2.035B sought); no ruling. OpenAI disputes the assessment's methodology. The government plaintiff is an interested party. Other outlets reporting the filing (Oregon Capital Chronicle, Lookout Eugene-Springfield, Engadget) were not logged because their pages could not be read for date (403) or were not opened.
